The '''Turtle Star''', added in [[Update Log|Update 13]], was a reward obtained from reaching Room 100 in the [[Infinity Castle]] (7th Season). Later, in Update 14 it was revealed to be [[Roshy]].

*<span data-darkreader-inline-color="" style="color:#fc4242;">This Star is sealed with a powerful magic and cannot be opened yet...</span>
